description: Commission of Elections - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Nos. 2061/42 and 2062/15 that published the names of elected and returned members - 2018
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns amendments to the list of elected and returned members for local authorities, as issued by the Elections Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It directly relates to electoral processes, specifically the official declaration and correction of election results, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
